summary.baseline: Over 10 years of cross-functional expertise bridging Radio Access Networks (4G/5G NR SA/NSA, Open RAN, Non-RT RIC) with Enterprise Data Engineering and Applied AI/ML workflows. Proven track record in orchestrating autonomous network features, delivering production-grade rApps, and designing scalable big data pipelines supporting over 10 million subscribers. Awarded Rakuten Group MVP for spearheading an AI-driven energy-saving solution that achieved a 15% reduction in network power consumption while maintaining strict SLA and KPI stability.

experience.role: RIC Operation and rApp Architect – Network Insight and Engineering Dept
highlights: **Open RAN & Non-RT RIC Validation:** Directed end-to-end integration, functional validation, and performance testing of Non-RT RIC platforms, ensuring continuous uptime and seamless multi-vendor interoperability.

**AI-Driven Power Optimization (Rakuten Group MVP):** Engineered and validated dynamic TX MIMO Muting rApp features during low-traffic windows, slashing monthly O-RU power consumption by 15% without degrading network KPIs.
**Hardware & L1 Anomaly Detection:** Built an automated Layer 1 (PHY) diagnostic framework parsing RIC platform logs to detect virtualized RAN hardware/RF malfunctions proactively.
**Automated Incident Ticketing:** Designed closed-loop operational workflows linking L1 anomaly detectors to automated trouble-ticketing systems, drastically reducing Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR).

**Automated PCI Optimization:** Deployed and validated a 3rd-party SON-based rApp for automated 5G NSA PCI conflict resolution, mitigating configuration errors and significantly lowering RRC connection drops.

**Dual Connectivity & Mobility Tuning:** Tuned and deployed internal rApps optimizing 5G NSA B1 thresholds, improving Inter-RAT handover success rates and stabilizing Dual Connectivity (EN-DC) for cell-edge users.

**RACH Procedure Optimization:** Spearheaded deep-dive root cause analyses of Random Access Channel failures; tuned preamble splits and power ramping parameters to elevate Call Setup Success Rates (CSSR).

experience.role: Customer Insight & Autonomous Optimization Lead – Network Insight and Engineering Dept
highlights: **High-Throughput Subscriber Pipelines:** Governed ETL architectures and scalable storage engines ensuring daily data availability and integrity across a base of 10+ million subscribers.
**Data Migration & Warehouse Engineering:** Engineered high-performance SQL ETL pipelines migrating terabyte-scale telecom data from OpenSignal BigQuery into Apache Cassandra and AWS S3 data lakes.
**Pioneering Telco LLM Use Cases:** Spearheaded the integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) to analyze unstructured network logs and drive automated decision-making.

**Data Pipeline Reliability:** Deployed an automated anomaly detection and alerting framework for missing Call Detail Records (CDR) on AWS S3, guaranteeing high data fidelity for downstream analytics.
**Spatial Analytics & Geolocation:** Enhanced network geolocation accuracy by 25% across diverse terrain and clutter profiles, enabling pinpoint radio planning and targeted rollout decisions.
**Autonomous Energy Saving:** Architected an energy-saving algorithm deployed inside the Self-Organizing Network (SON), achieving a measurable 15% reduction in network operational energy draw.
**Churn Prediction & User Segmentation:** Correlated subscriber call trace data with BSS records to generate high-fidelity behavioral profiles, driving precise churn prediction models.

experience.role: Data Analytics Lead – Network Intelligence and Analytics Dept
highlights: **Predictive Cell Deployment Algorithm:** Formulated an algorithmic framework optimizing 5G rollout, prioritizing capital expenditure (CapEx) in high-ROI areas through business effectiveness models.
**Customer Growth & ROI Monetization:** Led data-driven initiatives including a free NBA League Pass campaign POC, producing a 2% MoM subscriber growth and measurable revenue uplift.
**Churn Mitigation Analytics:** Conducted behavioral churn analysis using machine learning techniques to isolate drop-off drivers, informing targeted retention programs.
**Enterprise Executive Dashboards:** Designed and deployed centralized BI dashboards across Domo BI and PowerBI, tracking ARPU, device trends, and network health for C-level leadership.
